$comment: autoPort is false because this project genuinely needs port 3000, not any
free port: .env pins NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to http://localhost:3000, and
that value is what `pnpm verify` targets, what the OG image URLs are built
from, and what the send list puts in front of an admin as a guest's link.
On another port the acceptance checks fail against a server that is fine.
So if 3000 is busy, free it rather than moving off it - and check first
that the holder is not a dev server someone is deliberately running.
